parameters.help_en: The business tenant code. Default value: ALICOM_OPAAS
parameters.name: biz_code

parameters.help_en: The business extension information. Default value: an empty collection
parameters.help_zh: 业务扩展信息，默认为一个空集合
parameters.name: biz_extend

parameters.help_en: The start time. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时刻。时间戳，单位：秒
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end time. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时刻。时间戳，单位：秒
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: The flow code. You can view the flow code on the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page
parameters.help_zh: 流程编码。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码
parameters.name: flow_code

parameters.help_en: The flow version. On the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page, click the flow name to open the canvas and view the flow version
parameters.help_zh: 流程版本。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入流程编辑器画布界面查看流程版本
parameters.name: flow_version

parameters.help_en:
The metric name. Valid values:

- nodeUsageStatistics: node usage statistics.

- nodeErrorDetails: node error details
parameters.help_zh:
监控项名称。取值：

- nodeUsageStatistics：节点使用统计。

- nodeErrorDetails：节点错误明细
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en:
The extended parameter for the metric query. When MetricName is set to nodeErrorDetails, pass in a JSON string. Valid values for the JSON fields:

- pageNo: the current page number.

- pageSize: the number of entries per page.

- nodeId: the node ID. On the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page, click the flow name to open the canvas and copy the node ID
parameters.help_zh:
监控项查询的扩展参数。当MetricName为nodeErrorDetails时，需传入一段JSON数据。JSON字段取值：

- pageNo：当前页数。

- pageSize：每页显示数量。

- nodeId：节点ID，在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面点击流程名称进入画布编排界面复制节点ID
parameters.name: metric_param
